target_customer: Home service contractors (HVAC first, also plumbing, electrical, pest control) that employ field technicians
problem: Field technicians must diagnose, sell and do paperwork, and few do all three well. NOSO's agents automate notes, follow-ups and scheduling and help technicians capture sales.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to home service companies, integrated with CRMs such as ServiceTitan
product_category: AI agents for field service technicians

founders.name: Winston Chi
previous_startups: Butter Technologies (acquired by GrubMarket, per YC page)

founders.name: Alex Xi
education: PhD (institution not stated on YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: principal engineer who led a code LLM project, AI engineer at ByteDance and Meta.

competitors.name: ServiceTitan (Field Pro with Atlas)
competitors.what: AI assistant inside the dominant field service platform for diagnostics and sales prompts for technicians
competitors.traction_then: Incumbent platform used by many home service firms; Field Pro introduced at Pantheon 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice and text agents with two-way CRM sync and diagnostic accuracy are standard LLM engineering with hard parts around reliability and integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations help, but the main platform owner ServiceTitan ships a similar assistant, and LLM agents are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: ServiceTitan launched Field Pro with Atlas in 2025 and partnered with Bluon in October 2025 for HVAC diagnostics data, covering the same wedge.

market_need_then: Home service firms depend on technician quality for upsells and documentation; ServiceTitan and Bluon investing in the same area in 2025 shows demand for technician copilots.

branding.community_and_virality: A podcast episode on the HVAC trade (HVAC ADHD) covered the company; no other brand community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Small early brand with trade podcast mention and a bold tagline but no wider press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: NOSO LABS is an active YC Summer 2025 company with customers listed on its site including several HVAC and plumbing firms and claimed SOC 2 compliance. Funding is not verified and a large incumbent ships a similar assistant, so the outcome is open and no factors are assigned.
notes: Funding is unverified: aggregators report $500K pre-seed (VCBacked, PitchBook) while another reports $130K; investors listed include Rebel Fund, Asylum Ventures and Maiora Ventures. No primary source, so no round recorded. A directory claim of about $330K revenue is also unverified. Dashboard numbers on the site look illustrative. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed of 2025-09 is recorded from VCBacked and FundedIQ (PitchBook shows a September 2025 early-stage deal); investors are from PitchBook and VCBacked. No primary announcement, so it rests on databases only; another aggregator's 130K figure conflicts.
